description: List the command-line tools that ship with the specialist agents (complete agents built for one job, e.g. marketing, video generation, local LLMs). Each entry has a summary, the `specialists` it comes from, and `access`: "pro" tools are read-only (they inspect and report, never change anything) and read_agent_tool serves their files; "download" tools are bigger or change things (start runs, stop services, spend money), so read_agent_tool gives a short-lived download link for the whole tool instead. Both need Pro. `readable` says whether YOU can get it with your current access. Pass `query` to filter by keywords.

query.description: Optional keywords, matched against the name, summary and specialist.

name: list_agent_tools
title: List agent tools
